examples.target: 我諗緊轉職業。我想離開會計行業，變成設計師。
examples.en: I am thinking of changing careers. I want to leave accounting and become a designer.
Are you going to quit your job straight away?
What skills do you need to learn?

examples.target: 唔係，咁風險太大。我會先喺晚上讀書。
examples.en: No, that would be a big risk. I will study in the evenings first.

examples.target: 有，我以前嘅同學而家係我嘅導師，佢會俾坦白嘅意見我。
examples.en: Yes, a former classmate is my mentor now, and she gives me honest feedback.

dialogue.speaker: Betty
dialogue.text: 你呢排好興奮噃。發生咩事呀？
dialogue.en: You look so excited lately. What is going on?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 我諗緊轉職業。我想離開會計行業，變成設計師。
dialogue.en: I am thinking of changing careers. I want to leave accounting and become a designer.

dialogue.speaker: Betty
dialogue.text: 嘩，轉變好大喎！係咩令你決定咁做？
dialogue.en: Wow, that is quite a change! What made you decide?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 我意識到自己唔再有動力，而且我想份工有創意。
dialogue.en: I realized that I no longer feel motivated, and I want my work to be creative.

dialogue.speaker: Betty
dialogue.en: Are you going to quit your job straight away?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 唔係，咁風險太大。我會先喺晚上讀書。
dialogue.en: No, that would be a big risk. I will study in the evenings first.

dialogue.speaker: Betty
dialogue.en: What skills do you need to learn?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 主要係設計軟件同溝通，不過我已經有幾好嘅組織能力。
dialogue.en: Mainly design software and communication, but I already have good organizational skills.

dialogue.speaker: Betty
dialogue.text: 呢個係優勢。你喺呢個領域有冇認識人？
dialogue.en: That is an advantage. Do you know anyone in that field?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 有，我以前嘅同學而家係我嘅導師，佢會俾坦白嘅意見我。
dialogue.en: Yes, a former classmate is my mentor now, and she gives me honest feedback.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 唔係好貴。我搵到一個網上課程，費用比一個月嘅健身室會員卡仲平。
dialogue.en: Not too much. I found an online course that costs less than a monthly gym membership.

dialogue.speaker: Betty
dialogue.en: And what does your family think about it?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 佢哋好擔心，但係只要我有計劃，佢哋就支持我。
dialogue.en: They are worried, but they support me, as long as I have a plan.

dialogue.speaker: Betty
dialogue.text: 我佩服你嘅勇氣。好多人從來都唔踏出第一步。
dialogue.en: I admire your courage. Many people never take the first step.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 多謝。即使失敗，我都會學到新嘢。
dialogue.en: Thank you. Even if it fails, I will have learned something new.
